'''Typhloractyls''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Reptavian/Legends|reptavian]] creatures related to the [[Varactyl/Legends|Varactyls]]. They were kept as pets during the time of the [[Third Galactic War]]<ref name="Item">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|Item: "Coruscanti Typhloractyl"}}</ref> and could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].<ref name="LotS" />

Typhloractyls lacked visual organs and instead maneuvered using highly developed olfactory glands. They were highly averse to certain smells and were known to prefer cleaner environments. Traveling alongside Typhloractyls while carrying [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] was not recommended because of their sensitivity to scent.<ref name="Item" />

==Behind the scenes==
Typhloractyls first appeared in Galactic Season 8 "Rising Powers" in the [[January]] [[2025]] Game Update 7.6.1 of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="LotS" /> released in [[2022]] as the eighth digital expansion to the<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref> [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Release Date">{{TORweb|url=info/news/press-release/20111220|text=''Star Wars'': The Old Republic Goes Live Today}}</ref>
